source_summary: Freud S.p.A. general product catalogue (English), section "Routing tools for CNC machines": SCH solid carbide router cutters (Z1/Z2/Z3 up/down, Z2+2/Z3+3 compression, Z3 roughers) and NC12M spoilboard surfacing cutters. Freud publishes feed charts only as graphs (MDF/chipboard at 18,000 RPM); no chip-load table extracted. US hobby lines (75-xxx Premier spirals, V-groove bits) are not in this catalogue. Freud US (freudtools.com, Freud Tools North America): product pages (spec table: diameter, carbide height, overall length, shank, number of cutters, max RPM, angle, radius) for the Straight & Spiral line (75-/76-/77-/72-/73-/74-/79- Premier solid carbide, 04-/03-/16- carbide tipped), V-grooving, engraving, round nose, dish carving, lettering, keyhole, T-slot and dovetail bits; bearing-guided and profile bits excluded.
